title: Miniature Crane Claw Machine Diorama
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a miniature crane claw machine diorama game using Three.js and GLTFLoader. The scene should be a glass-box style claw machine containing collectible prizes, with a movable crane claw controlled by the player.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 12) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and two point lights: one warm (0xFFCC88) at (5, 10, 5) and one cool (0x88CCFF) at (-5, 10, -5), both intensity 0.8.
- Create a transparent glass box (the machine cabinet) using MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission=0.7, roughness=0.1, dimensions 8x10x8 centered at origin. The top should be open or have a slot for the claw arm.
- Inside the box, create a floor plane at y=-4 with a colorful material (0xFF6699).
- Load the 'AntiqueCamera.glb' model using GLTFLoader. Scale it to fit (scale 0.5) and place it as one of the collectible prizes on the floor at position (1, -3.5, 1). This is the "rare prize".
- Create 5 simple prize objects (colored spheres, radius 0.4) scattered on the floor at random but deterministic positions: (-2,-3.6,0), (0,-3.6,-2), (2,-3.6,1.5), (-1,-3.6,2), (1.5,-3.6,-1.5). Colors: red, blue, green, yellow, purple.
- Create the claw assembly: a vertical arm (thin cylinder) extending down from the top, ending in 3 claw fingers (thin cones or wedges) that can open/close. The claw starts at position (0, 3, 0).
- Add a horizontal rail system (visible bars) at the top of the machine for X and Z movement.

## Claw Mechanics & Physics
- The claw can move in X range [-3, 3] and Z range [-3, 3] at the top rail level (y=3).
- When dropped, the claw descends from y=3 to y=-3 at speed 3 units/sec, then the fingers close, then it ascends back to y=3 at speed 2 units/sec.
- When the claw is at the bottom and closes, check if any prize center is within 1.0 unit distance of the claw position (XZ only). If so, attach the nearest prize to the claw (it moves up with it).
- When the claw returns to the top, if it has a prize, move the claw to the drop chute at position (4, 3, 0), then release the prize (it falls and is "collected").
- Simple gravity: dropped/released prizes fall at acceleration 9.8 units/s². Prizes on the floor stay at y=-3.6 (spheres) or y=-3.5 (camera model).

## User Interactions
- Arrow keys (Left/Right) move the claw along X axis at speed 3 units/sec.
- Arrow keys (Up/Down) move the claw along Z axis at speed 3 units/sec.
- Spacebar triggers the drop sequence (only when claw is idle at top).
- 'R' key resets the entire game.
- A DOM button with id='drop-button' also triggers the drop (same as spacebar).

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- clawX: number (current claw X position)
- clawZ: number (current claw Z position)
- clawY: number (current claw Y position)
- clawState: string ('idle' | 'descending' | 'closing' | 'ascending' | 'delivering' | 'releasing')
- clawOpen: boolean (true if fingers are open, false if closed)
- prizesRemaining: number (count of prizes still on the floor, starts at 6)
- prizesCollected: number (count of collected prizes, starts at 0)
- heldPrize: string|null (name of currently held prize: 'sphere_red','sphere_blue','sphere_green','sphere_yellow','sphere_purple','antique_camera', or null)
- cameraModelLoaded: boolean (true once AntiqueCamera.glb is loaded)
- gameActive: boolean (true when game is running)
- dropCount: number (total number of drops attempted)
- score: number (score: normal spheres=10pts, antique_camera=50pts)

## HUD/UI
- A HUD overlay div (id='hud') in top-left showing: Score, Prizes Collected, Drops Used.
- The drop button (id='drop-button') styled as a large red circular button at bottom-center.
- A reset button (id='reset-button') at top-right.
- A status text (id='status-text') showing current claw state.

Ensure smooth animation loop with requestAnimationFrame. All state updates must be reflected in window.__3D_STATE__ every frame.
physics_constraints: Claw movement bounded to X:[-3,3], Z:[-3,3]. Claw descent from y=3 to y=-3 at 3u/s, ascent at 2u/s. Prize grab radius 1.0 units in XZ plane. Gravity 9.8u/s² for released objects. Floor collision at y=-3.6 for spheres. Score: spheres=10pts, camera=50pts.
